Package game.actions

Interface Consumable

All Known Implementing Classes:
CauliflowerItem, ConsumableItem, DriedProduct, FoodItem, MelonItem, ParsnipItem, PreservedProduct, ProcessedProduct, StrawberryItem, TomatoItem
public interface Consumable
Capability interface for Items that can be consumed by an Actor. Implementing classes define the effect of being consumed.

    • consume

      String consume(Actor actor)
      Applies the effect of consuming this Item to the given Actor.
      Parameters:
      actor - the Actor consuming this Item
      Returns:
      a description of what the effect actually did (e.g. the before/after value of whatever it changed), to be displayed to the player

    • canBeConsumedBy

      default boolean canBeConsumedBy(Actor actor)
      Tells whether the given Actor has what the effect of this Item needs. An effect that changes a statistic only works on an Actor that has that statistic, so an Actor without it must not consume the Item. Items whose effect needs nothing special keep the default, which allows every Actor.
      Parameters:
      actor - the Actor that would consume this Item
      Returns:
      true if consume(Actor) can be called with this Actor
